fact: A June 2025 technical note reports ReCoDe being piloted in five communes of the San region (Benena, Tominian, Sourountouna, San, Kava), of which three began building a database for local taxes and collecting by payment terminal, and that the Orange merchant code for tax payments exists only in Kava; the ReCoDe-COLLOC interface to the Treasury has been finalised.
title: Quel équilibre entre la dynamique sociale et le dispositif financier et technique dans les communes ?
